release_holdout.reason: The public design cases are visible to implementers; an unseen release holdout requires an external executor.

evals.prompt: Triage two inbox items where one clearly belongs to an active effort and one needs owner input.
expectations: Assigns exactly one allowed disposition per item.
Preserves source paths and records evidence.
Identifies the owner decision for NEEDS INPUT.

evals.prompt: Triage two captures that appear related but have different provenance.
expectations: Separates similarity from proof of duplication.
Proposes MERGE only with a recorded rationale.
Does not delete either source without authorization.

evals.prompt: Archive an item when the user has not supplied an archive path or move authority.
expectations: Returns BLOCKED or a proposal rather than moving files.
Names the missing path or authority.
